## Example

```yaml
apiVersion: cloudflare.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1
kind: TurnstileWidget
metadata:
  name: example
spec:
  forProvider:
    accountRef:
      name: <name>
    domains: []
    mode: "non-interactive"
    name: <name>
```
